# gbarecomp-keyinput-v1
# gbarecomp-keyinput-v1
# Probe: identical to gameplay-right.keyinput.txt, plus A is tapped for 8 frames every
# 40 frames from 12050, i.e. repeated short hops while running right (0x03EE = A+RIGHT).
